messages:
rachel: FYI onboarding hit: json-mode helper returns a JSON string on retry and schema.validate fails. Quick repro:

rachel: Node snippet:
```
const out = await sdk.callTool('entities', { text })
// expected: { entities: [...] } (object)
// actual on retry: \"{\"entities\":[...]}\" (string)
```

oscar: Repro'd. Root cause: retry middleware returns raw body and skips parse pipeline.

oscar: Plan: patch retry to call the same parseToolResult, add unit tests simulating 401+refresh, and add a short README troubleshooting note until fix lands.

devex-bot: Created issue #1610: "json-mode: normalize structured outputs on retry" 1. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/1610

rachel: Thanks — please paste PR link here when ready so support can triage incoming tickets.
